# Pull Request

## Summary

<!-- What does this PR add or change, and why? -->

## Type of change

- [ ] New skill
- [ ] Change to an existing skill
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Repository tooling (maintainers only)

## Checklist

- [ ] Each skill lives in `skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md`, and the `name` in its
      frontmatter matches the directory name
- [ ] Each skill has a clear `description` and instructions after the
      frontmatter
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, internal URLs, or customer data are included
- [ ] Helper files only do what the skill describes; no hidden network calls or
      commands
- [ ] I ran `pre-commit run --all-files` locally, or explain below why not
- [ ] I agree that my contribution is licensed under the [MIT License](../LICENSE)
